name: Indialantic Open 2019

venue.name: [Holy Name of Jesus Church](http://www.hnj.org)
venue.details: Grand hall, the building to the right of the courtyard

information: The main event of this competition is Pyraminx. If we get ahead in the schedule we will add a round of 3x3 One-Handed. We will advance 12 competitors to that added round. If you would like to staff for this competition please advise us by email. Your competition registration fee will be waived after the comp. Staff will also be provided lunch, snacks and drinks. We will be selling pizza, and other foods such as snacks and drinks.
